transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I mean, things have just gotten completely out of hand with my husband's family. I came in because I finally realized my in-laws aren't just arguing with me anymore. They're actually using the church altar and the parish committee to deliberately push me out. It's like they have this whole plan to make everyone forget everything I've done for this family over the years. I just couldn't ignore it anymore.
Have you been feeling unusually energetic or needing much less sleep than usual lately?

Yes, my sleep has definitely been affected lately. At first, I was sleeping only a couple of hours a night, and I'd still get right up to make lists. I had plenty of energy to do that. But now... well, now it's different. I just lie awake way before dawn worrying about everything, and I never really feel rested anymore.
Have you been feeling unusually cheerful or irritable lately, beyond your usual self?

Well, it's been a mix of both, honestly. There were days recently when I felt so... bright. Just really certain about everything I was doing. But then, if anyone questioned me about the altar, or what I was doing about it, I would just snap at them. I mean, I'd get so angry, like they were insulting my whole family. I just didn't have any patience for people doubting me.
Lately, have you felt that you had special powers, abilities, or importance beyond what other people would usually have?

Well... I wouldn't call it a superpower or anything like that. But I did feel... I mean, I truly believed I was the only one who could save our family's traditions. Like, nobody else saw how important it was. I just knew that if people would only listen to me and do exactly what I said, the whole community event at the church would be absolutely perfect. I felt like I was the only one who really understood what needed to be done.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?

Yes, actually. Um, on several nights recently, I heard my late mother's voice. She was telling me exactly where to put the marigolds and the candles for the altar. It sounded just like she was right there in the room with me. And... well, one time, I even saw her standing near the kitchen doorway. My husband was there and he said nobody was around, but I know what I saw and heard.
Have the voices or visions ever happened during a time when your mood felt completely normal?

No, they really haven't. Hearing her voice and... seeing her, that only happened during that specific time. You know, when I was barely getting any sleep and just rushing around the house, feeling so absolutely sure I had this special duty to fix up the altar. 

After that passed and my mood dropped... I mean, I still felt terrible, just really guilty and sad... but I wasn't hearing or seeing those things anymore. It never happens when I just feel like my normal self.
During that time, did you believe your in-laws were plotting against you?

Yes, I did. Actually, that's a big part of why I ended up coming in. I didn't think they were just arguing with me like normal... I knew they were actively plotting against me. I felt completely sure that they were using the altar preparations, and even the parish committee, to push me out. It felt like they were trying to make everyone forget everything I've done for this family over the years.
